Exact steps: Refresh a completed record, navigate away/back and sign out/sign in again. Verify status and quantities. If a save encounters a connection error, refresh the register before deciding to retry; keep the same source reference.
Test data: Never create a different reference just to force a retry
Expected result: Saved state persists. Refresh/retry does not duplicate postings or log the user out unexpectedly.

Exact steps: Review every Not run, Failed and Blocked result. Attach issue IDs and evidence, retest fixes, then fill Sign-off. Record which guardrail tests changed the baseline and the final reconciled balances.
Test data: Release decision is manual, not a calculated approval
Expected result: No critical access, duplication, negative-stock or reconciliation failure remains unresolved before real restaurant data is loaded.

Exact steps: Use Pending, Awaiting acceptance, Completed, Incomplete, Rejected and Cancelled filters, then search an exact reference. Verify the total and page count against the matching scoped records.
Test data: Filters must apply before pagination
Expected result: Only matching records appear, totals stay correct across pages, and alert links open their exact authorised record even when it is not on the first page.

Exact steps: Check the manager workspace for Approval needed. Approve and dispatch; check the receiving department workspace for Accept or reject incoming stock. Partially accept/reject and inspect follow-up alerts. Finish or resolve with evidence.
Test data: Leave the visible workspace open up to 30 seconds or refresh
Expected result: Relevant action alerts update for the right accounts, with no unrelated department data. Resolved work drops out. Items older than 24 hours are labelled; no email/SMS is implied.

Exact steps: Review the updated homepage and its stock handoff explanation. Open Sign in and Sign up; check readable labels, password visibility, keyboard focus, back link and narrow-screen layout. Open populated stock records and verify compact rows and 10-row pagination.
Test data: Do not alter another account's credentials
Expected result: Pages are readable, keyboard-accessible and do not overflow the viewport. Authentication/invitation flows still work; tables retain readable numeric columns without excessive row height.
